title: Pan-Seared Tuna with French Indian Sauce
description: A fusion of French and Indian flavors, this dish features seared tuna steaks served with a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: Season the tuna steaks with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp of butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tuna steaks and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Remove the tuna from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp of butter. Add the Indian spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the kidney beans, coriander powder, and garam masala to the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid has almost completely evaporated.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the tuna steaks to the skillet and spoon some of the sauce over the top of each steak.
Simmer the tuna in the sauce for 1-2 minutes, or until heated through.
Serve the tuna steaks hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
